$comment: CSS-only components that style markup owned by something else. An agent never emits this markup, so the markup-contract eval (E07) does not apply to them; llms-patterns.txt tells agents where the markup comes from instead of giving a skeleton. Key: component name from src/scss; host: who emits the markup.

layout.reason: the screen layout skeleton (.screen-container > .layout) comes from the template's Layout block

content.reason: the .content region and its title/actions rows are placeholders of the Layout block

header.reason: the header is a placeholder group of the Layout block

header-layout-native.reason: header variant of the native layout

header-layout-side.reason: header variant of the side-menu layout

menu.reason: the application menu container and overlay come from the Menu block

menu-layout-native.reason: menu variant of the native layout

menu-layout-side.reason: menu variant of the side-menu layout

menu-app-login-info.reason: the signed-in user block is part of the Menu block

menu-app-menu-links.reason: the navigation links are generated by the Menu block from the app's screens

menu-header-logo.reason: the logo slot is part of the Menu block

login.reason: the login screen and its form come from the template's common screen

themegrid-container.reason: the grid container wraps header, content and footer placeholders of the Layout block

animate.reason: effect classes applied to any element; no anatomy of its own

align-center.reason: an alignment class applied to any element; no anatomy of its own

ios-bounce.reason: a fix applied to the native layout by the runtime; no markup of its own

pull-to-refresh.reason: the pull indicator is injected by the platform runtime

balloon.reason: a floating layer created and positioned by the patterns that use it; measured through their stories
